name: Secure household invitation and person-first journey
covers: fixed bottom Save and Continue CTA and natural scrolling in Viber
setup: Sign in as the organizer and generate four V3 household invite links.
description: Follow an individual household invitation, RSVP and complete Evgeni then Iliyana then Ivelin, retaining separate answers.
steps: Open the new Villa landing page, confirm it shows 31 December to 2 January and use 'Попълни за семейството' to open the household list
Open the generated V3 invitation link for Evgeni and Iliyana
Optionally set an individual day of attendance for one family member; do not automatically assign the same dates to everyone
Confirm attendance for all three family members and save
Select several food choices for Evgeni and continue through his questions
Confirm that the next person is Iliyana, not another family-wide food category
Complete Iliyana and verify the next person is Ivelin with child-safe drinks
On a narrow mobile viewport, scroll through multiple photo rows while Save and Continue remains visible above the bottom safe area
Reopen the same invitation in the same browser
expected: The real villa landing offers a mobile-friendly entry to the secure person-first flow; guest answers remain separate and all return after reopening.

name: Unauthorized access and legacy closure
description: Uninvited guests cannot read or change any household records; legacy routes are closed.
steps: Open the public home page without an invitation
Choose a household and try an incorrect access code
Verify that no household answers are returned
Attempt to use an old V2 session via the legacy routes
Open the organizer area while logged out
expected: Invalid access is denied, old public session endpoints return HTTP 410, and admin data remain gated by organizer sign-in.

name: Multiple-choice, conflicts and child-safe selections
description: Food multi-select, member-specific restrictions, and concurrent edits are correctly protected.
steps: From a valid family invitation choose several dishes for one adult
Save and navigate back to verify all selections remain
Choose child drinks and verify beer and spirits are absent
In restrictions explicitly choose Unknown or provide a named allergen
Complete shared table and organization choices
Check separate breakfast and dessert topics per member; multiple choices remain saved
expected: Selections remain per person, children never receive alcohol choices, skipped questions are distinct, and conflicting concurrent saves are rejected.

name: Anonymous social preferences and private household AI
description: Aggregate food trends use distinct confirmed participants and only display when privacy threshold is met.
steps: Collect confirmed food choices from at least two people in a second household
Open the first family invitation
Look for the What others like area in the food step
Ask the AI helper a question about this family menu
Type a food preference in free Bulgarian text, use AI extraction and confirm suggested selections before saving
expected: Only aggregate foods with at least two votes appear, without names or restrictions. The personal assistant's context-aware question and AI-extracted choices are shown without silently overwriting the guest's selections.

name: Organizer overview and shopping plan
description: Organizer can view all four families, copy invitations, and generate a menu without duplicating V3 records.
steps: Sign in with the authorized organizer account
Open the V3 organizer block and copy a household invitation link
Inspect family progress and individual food choices
Generate a common menu after confirmed answers have been saved
Review the shopping list and ensure previously purchased items remain marked after regeneration
Open the new menu planner: approve dishes and explicit serving counts for each of seven meals across three days
Open the new shopping list and mark a product bought
Update villa information and verify it persists after reload
expected: Organizer sees correct per-member answers, invitations, a consolidated menu and stable purchased markers.
